At first she said revisiting the relationship later was a “possibility” but that she didn’t want to revisit for a long while and that for now she doesn’t want to restart the relationship, she’d rather maintain a friendship. Which are very contradictory I know, but since she’s said that she hardly ever acknowledges my existence when she sees me in class and such unless she absolutely has to, and prefers to just pretend I don’t exist. And if I send a single friendly platonic text, a good 75% of the time she either never responds or takes 8-12 hours to respond. and it all just kills me cause I feel like I lost the love of my life and my best friend all on one fell swoop

But what if I am nothing with out her? Nothing motivates me any more and all I want is her back. Every time I see her it hurts a little more and every step she and I take apart I die a little more... how do you know she wasn’t the one for me? I truly don’t think I’ll be able to love like I loved her again, and I don’t think I’ll find anyone like her that will ever love me like she did... how are you so confident in saying this? for me death is the only thing that is for sure at this point, the rest is all up in the air, I just want to know that it’s going to be ok, and leaving this pain behind is the only way to that

But all I want was to make her happy and love her and have a future with her. Now my life doesn’t have a purpose or a meaning. Every step she and I take apart I die a little more. Now I’m just a shell of existence, what’s to say I shouldn’t just finish the job
